MFE_H: max(valid comparable high in indices 1..H / reference price - 1)
MAE_H: min(valid comparable low in indices 1..H / reference price - 1)
RET_H: comparable close at exact holding index H / reference price - 1; unavailable endpoint => null
TIME_TO_MFE_H: first 1-based holding index reaching H-window maximum
coverage: observed valid bars / H exchange sessions; suspension and missing count in H, not observed
corporate_action: qualified PIT raw-to-reference scale factor(day)/factor(reference date), else CORPORATE_ACTION_UNRESOLVED
